KP 1. Determining Whether a p-Series with Integer Exponent Converges
1.?

Use the p-test to determine whether the series below converges or diverges. ∑n=1∞52n3

Note that the factor of 52 multiplying the series has no effect on the convergence/divergence of the series.

3.?

Determine whether the series ∑n=1∞4n56 converges or diverges.

M
Wed, Aug 5th @ 1:42 PM|Elapsed: 0:07Correct

The series can be written as 4∑n=1∞1n5/6, which is a p-series with p=56. Since p≤1, the series is divergent.

Note that the factor of 4 multiplying the series has no effect on the convergence/divergence of the series.

4.?

Determine whether the series ∑n=1∞2n2n converges or diverges.

M
Wed, Aug 5th @ 1:44 PM|Elapsed: 1:11Correct

The series can be written as

2∑n=1∞1n2+1/2=2∑n=1∞1n5/2, which is a p-series with p=52. Since p>1, the series is convergent.

Note that the factor of 2 multiplying the series has no effect on the convergence/divergence of the series.

KP 3. Determining Which Series Converge From a List
5.?

Which of the following series are convergent?

  1. ∑n=1∞1n
  2. ∑n=1∞1n3
  3. ∑n=1∞3n73
M
Wed, Aug 5th @ 1:44 PM|Elapsed: 0:23Correct

We analyze each series in turn.

  • The series ∑n=1∞1n is a p-series with p=1 (the harmonic series). Since p≤1, the series diverges by the p-series test.

  • The series ∑n=1∞1n3 is a p-series with p=3. Since p>1, the series is convergent by the p-series test.

  • For the third series, we have ∑n=1∞3n73=3∑n=1∞1n7/3, which is a p-series with p=73. Since p>1, the series is convergent by the p-series test.

Hence, the correct answer is "II and III only".

6.?

Which of the following series are convergent?

  1. ∑n=1∞2nn23
  2. ∑n=1∞13n4
  3. ∑n=1∞5n3n
M
Wed, Aug 5th @ 1:46 PM|Elapsed: 1:38Correct

We analyze each series in turn.

  • First, we look at ∑n=1∞2nn23. Rewriting this series gives ∑n=1∞2nn23=2∑n=1∞1n⋅n2/3=2∑n=1∞1n5/3, and this is a p-series with p=53. Since p>1, the series converges by the p-series test.

  • For the second series, we have ∑n=1∞13n4=13⋅∑n=1∞1n4 which is a p-series with p=4. Since p>1, the series is convergent.

  • For the third series, we have ∑n=1∞5n3n=5∑n=1∞n1/3n1/2=5∑n=1∞1n1/6, and this is a p-series with p=16. Since p≤1, the series diverges by the p-series test.

Hence, the correct answer is "I and II only."

KP 4. Convergence Parameters for p-Series
7.?

For which values of q does the series ∑n=1∞1nq−2 converge?

E
Wed, Aug 5th @ 1:47 PM|Elapsed: 0:46Correct

A p-series is any series that takes the form ∑n=1∞1np,

where p is a constant. The p-series test states that

  • if p>1, then the series converges, while

  • if p≤1, then the series diverges.

Comparing our series to the p-series, we have

p=q−2.

According to the p-series test, the given series converges if

q−2>1⟹q>3.

Therefore, the series is convergent for all q>3.

8.?

For which values of q does the series ∑n=1∞1n4q−1 converge?

E
Wed, Aug 5th @ 1:47 PM|Elapsed: 0:24Correct

A p-series is any series that takes the form ∑n=1∞1np,

where p is a constant. The p-series test states that

  • if p>1, then the series converges, while

  • if p≤1, then the series diverges.

Comparing our series to the p-series, we have

p=4q−1.

According to the p-series test, the given series converges if

4q−1>1⟹q>12.

Therefore, the series is convergent for all q>12.
